permittedAssertionTransformations.rule: Jest .toEqual(x) normalizes to Vitest .toBe(x); trailing commas and whitespace inside literals are ignored.
nodeRef.current / firstNodeRef.current / querySelector("#id") / node() normalize to a generic NODE subject; childNodes.length and querySelectorAll(...).toHaveLength(n) both mean childCount n.
Upstream ENTERED/ENTERING/EXITED/EXITING/UNMOUNTED template literals fold to their lowercase status strings.
CSSTransition "-entering" class tokens alias to "-enter-active" when comparing classContains observations.
console/warning spy call assertions are optional on the adapted side when the scenario still covers the behavioral observations.
Transition callback / listener / ref spy assertions are required. An adapted callOrder/log array observation may cover upstream callback spy assertions for the same lifecycle.
Adapted textContent observations may contain the upstream text (or vice versa) after status folding.
Upstream presence/null checks and empty textContent map to adapted emptyText, presence (absence), or status unmounted observations.
